verses.verse:
अंगुली लाघवार्थ हि क्वचित् स्वस्थान लंघनम्।
हस्त लाघवमादाय छिद्राणाम् वक्रता क्वचित्।।३२।।
verses.text: For ease of the fingers a hole sometimes leaves its proper place; and for ease of the hand the holes are sometimes set out of line.

commentary.text: Sometimes, when making a large flute, one also has to think whether, if the holes are made according to the marks fixed at their proper places, there will be special difficulty in placing the fingers. If there will be, some remedy is needed for that too. The above śloka gives the solution to this. First divide this difficulty into two parts: (1) the distance between the holes being greater than the spread of the fingers; (2) because the fingers are unequal, the short finger not reaching level with the long finger. Now for the first difficulty we can move the holes a little up or a little down from their fixed place; but when moving one down, do not forget to make it bigger as well, and when moving one up, to make the hole smaller than its fixed limit. In the same way, for the second difficulty we can move the holes to the right and left of the straight line. In this procedure the hole need not be made larger or smaller than its proper limit, because holes moved to the right or left of the line undergo no change in their sound. For this reason the hole of madhya Pañcama is made on the opposite side of the line, and it is closed with the thumb. Now the limits of the holes are considered: how much widening or narrowing of which hole can be justified.

terms.en: svasthāna — group from a fixed note up to the fourth
